title: Annual reporting of frozen assets held for designated persons
summary: Anyone holding or controlling funds or economic resources of a designated person must complete OFSI's frozen asset reporting form for the 2026 review by 30 November 2026.
what_changes: HM Treasury runs a frozen asset review every year to update its records of changes to accounts.
Holders of funds or economic resources of a designated person must complete the reporting form.
For the 2026 exercise, the form must reach OFSI by 30 November 2026.
The 2026 reporting notice and reporting template were updated on 30 September 2026.
who_it_applies_to: Firms that hold or control funds or economic resources belonging to a person designated under UK financial sanctions.

history.event: OFSI published the 2026 frozen asset reporting notice and template, with a 30 November 2026 deadline.

admin_notes: An admin archived this change on 2026-11-16. Reason: Workflow test
